# AbsentLayer

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Generation` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public record AbsentLayer
```

One layer the roll left out of this asset entirely.

## Remarks

Recorded because an absent layer is otherwise INVISIBLE in a finished Set: it contributes no trait, so nothing downstream can tell "this asset has no hat" from "this collection has no hat layer". The OpenSea file still omits it — that is the standard reading of not having something, and it is built from [`GeneratedAsset.Traits`](Nfty.Core.Generation.GeneratedAsset.md#p-traits), which an absent layer never enters. This travels in the rich nfty file instead, which is what the dual-metadata split is for.

- `IngredientName` (`string`) - Its display name — the trait type it would have been published under had it appeared, which is what a rarity table needs to name it.
